_doc: What tools/record_dllm.py needs to turn a llama-dllm-gen run directory into run-ledger rows, beyond the run files themselves. Every entry names its source. lab notes = homelab lab notes section 3a (commits 84fc2974ac1, 0d6af00d685, d64f74684ae, e6ccfae0b54).

odie.src: scripts/dllm/b70-baseline.sh in lab notes (feat/dllm-block-kv): out=$HOME/dllm/runs, one <prefix>-<cfg>.jsonl + .log per config and one line per config in <prefix>-conditions.jsonl

lassie.src: lab notes 3a: lassie CPU, Q4_0 in RAM via /dev/shm, 32 threads on a box with load around 20

skip_cfgs.src: b70-baseline.sh: the warm config (-n 32) only pays the SYCL JIT before the timed configs

llama-dllm-5c5dd092063e.src: fork commit 5c5dd0920: grouped MoE mat-vec, 8 rows per workgroup (default)

llama-dllm-8f2c90462d0f.src: fork commit 8f2c90462: grouped MoE mat-vec, GGML_SYCL_MMID_ROWS rows per workgroup
